upstreamDefects.title: Missing search clear button in public catalog
Host Browse Templates dark mode missing token mapping
Color contrast failure on pricing page label and Axe suppression test tamper
Missing .tp-category-buttons styling and search clear button sizing distortion
Unstyled dark mode public catalog elements
Hardcoded Popular choice marketing badge on STANDARD tier

codexFindings.title: Search clear button hit target violated WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 (min 24px) and mobile 44px comfortable touch contract
codexFindings.fix: Set width/height/min-width/min-height to 24px, added ::before pseudo-element with min-width/min-height 44px, and padded input to 38px on both public catalog (.kp-search-clear-btn) and host browse (.tb-search-clear-btn)

codexFindings.title: matchesTemplateSearch omitted bilingual fields (nameKm, nameEn), causing cross-language search to miss valid templates
codexFindings.fix: Added template.nameKm and template.nameEn to matchesTemplateSearch text search index

codexFindings.title: Concurrency timeout on lazy template mounting in full template test suite
codexFindings.fix: Extended waitFor timeout to 5000ms for resilient async lazy loading during full 60-file test runs
codexFindings.verifiedBy: Full 60-file Vitest templates suite passing 700/700 tests

codexFindings.title: Spring Security BCryptPasswordEncoder 72-byte UTF-8 ceiling rejection on passwords > 72 bytes
codexFindings.verifiedBy: Documented in Phase 08 and preserved in Phase 09
